clientId.title: Client ID
clientId.description: OAuth2 client ID for introspection request

clientSecret.title: Client Secret
clientSecret.description: OAuth2 client secret for introspection request. NB: use a secret placeholder rather than plain text

clientAuthenticationMethod.title: Client Authentication
clientAuthenticationMethod.description: OAuth2 client authentication type for introspection

introspectEndpoint.title: Introspect Endpoint
introspectEndpoint.description: OAuth2 introspect endpoint - leave blank for local introspection

clientProfile.title: HTTP Client Profile
clientProfile.description: HTTP client profile to use. Must be configured in HTTP client service. Leave blank for no profile

bearerType.title: Token Bearer Type
bearerType.description: Specify how the token is presented - as an authorisation header, a callback shared state variable, or URL parameter. URL parameter to be used with caution

bearerIdentifier.title: Token Bearer Identifier
bearerIdentifier.description: Custom header name, shared state variable, or URL parameter name. Leave blank for standard authorization header

saveResults.title: Save Result to State
saveResults.description: Save entire introspection result to shared state - variable tokenIntrospectResult

mapAttributesToState.title: Map Claims to Journey State
mapAttributesToState.description: Map introspection results to shared or transient state properties. Key is the shared state property, Value is the introspect claim name - e.g. Key: username, Value: user_id, or Key: objectAttributes.mail, Value: email

requiredClaims.title: Required Claims
requiredClaims.description: Required claims and their values in introspect results - Key is required claim name, Value is the required value - e.g. Key: client_id, Value: mobileApp

allowedClients.title: Allowed Clients
allowedClients.description: Restrict access to known OAuth2 clients. Leave empty for all clients
